item.title: Alibaba Cloud’s 2026 Apsara Conference: Full-Stack AI Roadmap Along with Global Market Expansion Plan
item.dc:creator: Alizila Staff
item.description: At the 2026 Apsara Conference, Alibaba Cloud’s annual flagship technology conference, Alibaba unveiled a roadmap for its full-stack AI strategy spanning chips, cloud infrastructure, models and agents, alongside plans for its first cloud regions in Türkiye, Finland and the Netherlands and a target of more than 20 GW of global data center capacity by 2032.
item.content:encoded:
At the 2026 Apsara Conference, Alibaba Cloud’s annual flagship technology conference, Alibaba unveiled a roadmap for its full-stack AI strategy spanning chips, cloud infrastructure, models and agents, alongside plans for its first cloud regions in Türkiye, Finland and the Netherlands and a target of more than 20 GW of global data center capacity by 2032.

“The theme of this year’s Apsara Conference is ‘Intelligence Goes Beyond,'” said Joe Tsai, Chairman of Alibaba Group.

item.title: Alibaba Group Honored by Fortune’s 2026 Change the World List for Bringing AI to Those in Need
item.dc:creator: Alizila Staff
item.description: Alibaba Group has been named to Fortune’s 2026 Change the World list for expanding AI access for the underserved consumers and SMEs, marking its eighth appearance on the list.
item.content:encoded:
Alibaba Group has been named to Fortune’s 2026 Change the World list for expanding AI access for the underserved consumers and SMEs, marking its eighth appearance on the list. The recognition reflects the company’s long-standing approach to building technology around practical problems.

Annualized AI-related product revenue reached $7.3 billion and is projected to reach $10 billion in the September quarter.

item.title: AliViews: Eddie Wu Shares Alibaba’s Strategic Full-Stack AI Roadmap at the 2026 Apsara Conference
item.dc:creator: Alizila Staff
item.description: Apsara Conference, Alibaba Cloud’s annual flagship event, kicked off on Sept. 22, 2026 in Hangzhou.
item.content:encoded:
Apsara Conference, Alibaba Cloud’s annual flagship event, kicked off on Sept. 22, 2026 in Hangzhou. Eddie Wu, CEO of Alibaba Group, delivered a keynote speech sharing the company’s perspective of the “Machine Intelligence” era and its strategic roadmap forward.

Our target is that by 2032, the global data center capacity operated by Alibaba Cloud will surpass 20GW, fueling the industry’s exponentially rising demand for AI.
